_doc: ENRICHMENT SOURCES — per facet, which connector authoritatively serves
it, in precedence order, and the tier band its output lands at.
The facets are the ledger's seven (FACETS in apps/mcp/dma_mcp/ledger.py
and migration 0051) plus thought_leadership, which the enrichment
register tracks as a surface (overview.thought_leadership in
packages/shared/enrichment_register.json) but the ledger does not
version.
`status` is grounded in the repo, not in intent:
wired                 a code path or producer-session connector exists
and is named in `grounding`
wired, not live       declared in code that records NOT_RUN with a
reason until a missing credential exists
declared, not wired   named in a skill or plan only — no code path,
no repo consumer. Listing it here grants nothing.
Nothing in this file opens a path into serving content. Whatever the
connector, the value travels the only path content may take: registered
through register_evidence citing the SOURCE the tool surfaced — never
the tool — and submitted through the connector (invariant 2). Tier
bands follow the underlying source per 02-inputs/clay_taxonomy.json and
01-start-here/2-evidence.md; a value with no traceable source is an
inference at any tier.
Sources are ordered: the first entry is the one to try first, and a
later entry supplements rather than replaces an earlier one.

sources.notes: CORRECTED 2026-08-23, and the previous note was costing every run its technographics. It read 'Ingest-scan only — no live API: the key is not in Secret Manager, and the routine records NOT_RUN with that reason until it is', which conflated TWO paths. The ingest scan does need a Secret Manager key and does not have one. The PRODUCER SESSION does not use a key at all — Vibe Prospecting/Explorium is an MCP connector authenticated at the session, it is in the routine's auto-approve list (scripts/hooks/autoapprove_connector.py: match-business, enrich-business, fetch-entities), and it answers. Measured 2026-08-23 on three promoted clients: baxter-credit-union 392 premium technologies, axos-bank 357, logix-federal-credit-union 147, each broken into ~20 named categories (finance, IT security, platform and storage, BI and analytics, ...) and naming real core systems — Symitar Episys and Temenos for Baxter, Symitar Episys and Fiserv and FICO Falcon for Logix, Jack Henry SilverLake and nCino and Yodlee for Axos. Cost is 2 credits per enrichment per row. So a producer recording NOT_RUN for this facet was recording it for a source it could reach, which is how a register reaches a client with ten named products. WHAT EXPLORIUM IS FOR: it is the CANDIDATE LIST that makes the recursive search converge, not the citation. The tool console (vibeprospecting.explorium.ai) is still never a citable source (scripts/check_evidence.py TOOL_HOSTS) — each candidate is corroborated through a job posting, the entity's newsroom, a vendor release or a live technical read, and carries CONFIRMED/INFERRED/CLAIMED accordingly.
